title: Atlas 2 -- Foundation models for clinical deployment
text: on eighty benchmarks from five different public benchmark suits covering a wide variety of tasks, datasets, and tissue types. While further improvements and benchmarking are warranted, our models outperform all other evaluated pathology foundation models on the vast majority of benchmarks and demonstrate that tradeoffs for clinical deployments of pathology foundation models can effectively be minimized.
